slides.text: Three guardians remain. The Gatekeeper, in the dungeon halls. The Crimson Warden, in the vaults below. The Harbor Tyrant, at the edge of the sea.
A tap will not wake them. A swing thrown with everything you have will. Strike true.
Your pulse is the only light. Keep it burning.

levels.intro: He guards the first hall. He is slow, and he is testing you.
Faster, and he watches where you strike. Vary your swings.
The last guardian. Choose your weapon. Do not stand still.

guardians.name: The Gatekeeper
guardians.lore: He has held the first hall longer than anyone remembers. He fights to test you, not to finish you.
tips: Watch for the red flash before he swings.
Hit him between attacks. A hard swing makes him flinch.

guardians.name: The Crimson Warden
guardians.lore: Hunger made him patient. He watches how you swing and learns it.
tips: Vary your swing direction. He is more likely to guard an angle you repeat.
Watch his flames flare before a heavy strike.

guardians.name: The Harbor Tyrant
guardians.lore: The sea gave him a crown of fire. It takes anyone who stands still.
tips: Choose your weapon before he rises.
Move out of the glowing ground marker. His big slam cannot be blocked.

interludes.afterLevel1: The first gate opens. Below, something is watching how you swing.
interludes.afterLevel2: The vault falls silent. Ahead, the sea wind carries the smell of smoke.
ending: The last guardian kneels. The arenas go quiet.
The Trials do not end with a victory. They end when you decide you are ready to rest.
Breathe. Your pulse is still burning.
interludes.defeat: Rest. Breathe. The guardians will wait.
